
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /kill  (/stop, /abort)                     │
  │  Emergency Stop                             │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    EMERGENCY: Immediately terminate the agent.

  Usage:
    /kill
    /stop
    /abort

  Details:
    Force-kills RadSim immediately. Use when the agent is stuck or
    doing something unexpected. Prefer /exit for normal shutdown.

  Examples:
    $ /kill
    $ /stop

  Tips:
    Tip: Only use in emergencies — /exit is safer for normal use.

  Related: /exit
